title: Supported vs unsupported actions/modes

rewrite.control_http: 400 with explicit error; never save; never silent-allow
rewrite.existing_rows: compiler remaps rewrite -> redact for gateway bundles; data migration rewrites stored FirewallConfig/Rule rewrite to redact
rewrite.runtime_output_guard_verdict: gateway enforce_output may still see scanner verdict rewrite (not an operator capability). L01-2 is the control-plane write path.
rewrite.fail_if: UI label exists and control saves rewrite as allow/no-op

l01_1: Save each supported action/mode in real UI/API, reload, map stored value / compiled plan / runtime Redis firewall:config:{slug}. Do not use /health.enforcement_mode (global liar) or policy_cache_version (not bumped by FirewallConfig save).
l01_2: POST/PUT rewrite on FirewallConfig output_*_action and Rule.action must 400. Fail if 201/200.
l01_3: pii_detection_enabled=false removes the INPUT scanner PII floor. Auth, tenant isolation, firewall_enabled, secrets/DoS floor stay. Do not set firewall_enabled=false. Residual: AKIA classified as threat_type=pii so PII-off can leak AWS-key-shaped tokens unless a secret/credential rule matches.
